content:
Today we’d like to introduce you to Brian Bellingar.

Hi Brian, thanks for sharing your story with us. To start, maybe you can tell our readers some of your backstory.
PFC Paranormal started with our founder, Misty, who built the team on a simple idea: when people are frightened in their own homes, they deserve honest answers, not a bill and not a performance. When she stepped back, she handed leadership to me — a Navy veteran who now works as a flight simulator technician in Jacksonville — and we’ve carried that same mission forward.

Today we’re a volunteer team of investigators from all walks of life — veterans, a radio DJ, a banker, mediums and skeptics alike — serving Northeast Florida, Central Florida, and Southern Georgia. We investigate homes and historic locations, review evidence carefully, and tell people the truth about what we find — including when the truth is that we found nothing at all. That honesty-first approach has taken us from quiet house calls to being featured on local news, but the mission hasn’t changed: residential investigations are always free, and always will be.

Alright, so let’s dig a little deeper into the story – has it been an easy path overall and if not, what were the challenges you’ve had to overcome?
It has not always been a smooth road. Everything we do is self-funded — professional-grade cameras, audio gear, and monitoring equipment come out of our own pockets, because we refuse to pass that cost on to the families who call us. We’re all volunteers with day jobs and families, so every investigation is a late night somebody chose to give.

The bigger challenge is trust. The paranormal field has a credibility problem, and honestly, some of it is earned. We’ve had to work twice as hard to show homeowners, businesses, and local media that we’re serious: we document everything, we debunk our own evidence first, and we’d rather tell a client “your house is fine” than invent a ghost. Slowly, that reputation has become the thing we’re known for.

Thanks – so what else should our readers know about PFC Paranormal?
PFC Paranormal is a volunteer paranormal investigation team based in St. Johns County, Florida. We conduct residential and historic-location investigations, evidence reviews, and historical research into the locations we visit. What we’re known for is our evidence standard: we rule out the ordinary first — electrical interference, plumbing, building settling, dust, sound bleed — and we publish what survives that process, labeled honestly.

What sets us apart is simple: we never charge for residential investigations, and we never guarantee a haunting. If we find a natural explanation, that’s the answer we deliver, warmly and straight. Brand-wise, we’re most proud that families trust us in their homes at their most vulnerable moments — and that local outlets have started coming to us when they want the paranormal covered responsibly.

What matters most to you? Why?
What matters most to me is that a family can sleep in their own home again. People don’t call us because they want to be on TV — they call because something in their house scares them and they don’t know where else to turn. Whether the answer turns out to be a spirit, a furnace, or a raccoon in the attic, what they needed was someone to take them seriously and tell them the truth. That, and doing this work with integrity — the moment an investigator starts performing instead of investigating, they’ve stopped helping anybody.

Pricing:

  • Residential investigations: ALWAYS FREE.
  • Historic/public location investigations and events: contact us.
  • Merchandise (Fourthwall shop) supports equipment and operating costs.
